description: The same Svelte 5 SvGrid, same data and columns, rendered as a full calendar by setting one scheduler prop. Rows become events bucketed by time; the toolbar switches Month, Week, Day and Agenda views; drag an event to reschedule, drag its edge to resize and click to edit in a drawer, with onEventMove and onEventResize writing the new times back onto your row so the Table view agrees. The calendar renderer ships in @svgrid/enterprise.
keywords: svelte event calendar drag and drop
svelte month week day agenda views

faq.question: What does the scheduler prop need at minimum?
faq.answer: startField and endField naming the columns that hold the times, plus titleField for the label. Everything else, views, colours, resources and editing callbacks, is optional.

faq.question: How do drags reach my data?
faq.answer: onEventMove and onEventResize receive the row and the new start and end; you assign them to the row and the calendar and the table both re-render from the same array.

faq.question: Is the scheduler free?
faq.answer: The scheduler prop and the data model are in @svgrid/grid; the calendar renderer is part of @svgrid/enterprise, which runs without a key while you evaluate, with a small watermark.
